verdict.rationale: Superpowers installs through each harness's own plugin mechanism, such as `/plugin install` or `devin plugins install` (docs-48, docs-36, docs-7). Its docs reference a user-level `~/.agents/skills/` path recognized across runtimes (docs-31), which implies user-global placement. Nothing shows a documented choice between a repo-committed, project-local install and a user-global one; scope appears to be whatever each harness's installer does. Missing for 10: explicit project-local install option committed with the repo, documented scope selection, per-harness scope guidance, hands-on corroboration.
